## Koottamundu Glass Temple
![Pilgrimage ](https://www.bwstays.com/assets/img/pilgrimage/bw-workation-jain-glass-temple-wayanad.webp)

### Pilgrimage

[View places within 15 Kms](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-koottamundu-glass-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html#nearby-places)

? 4.07 km from Kalpetta

- Timing: 9:00 am – 18:30

- Transportation: Public
- Best Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 000 0000
- ![Black and White Stays Wayanad](https://www.bwstays.com/assets/img/icons/cloudy.png)Weather:

Koottamundu Glass Temple is a stunning Jain temple full of glass mirrors, built to honour the great saint of Jains in the Wayanad district in the state of Kerala in India
